propositions: Automated bug filers can spam duplicate tickets, file single flakes, or silently break when create args or gates change.

Heartbeat-alert filer must implement a 2-consecutive-red threshold using workflow run history; binding-drift filer must skip threshold (drift is persistent, not flaky); conflict filer must use stable dedup tag from local id + Jira key.

All auto-bug filers must abort with exit code 1 and loud log if detail is empty, use stable per-check dedup tags searched with has-tag, accumulate at most one comment per 24h via marker-line dedup, and stamp REBAR_DETECTED_BY env var.
Heartbeat and binding-drift filers keep existing auto-close behavior on green via rebar transition; conflict filer must not auto-close (needs adjudication).
Bug-creation contract must document exact rebar create args, exit codes, dedup search command, REBAR_DETECTED_BY semantics, and per-filer pattern rationale in audit table.
